requirements.text: ECL estimates are unbiased and probability-weighted, reflect a range of possible outcomes and the time value of money, and use reasonable and supportable information available without undue cost or effort.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0). Paraphrases the IFRS 9 measurement objective; no IFRS text quoted.

requirements.text: ECL risk parameters exclude prudential conservatism: margins of conservatism, downturn components and regulatory floors are not included.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: The IFRS 9 definition of default equals the prudential definition of CR-STD-110, and Stage 3 comprises all exposures in default under that definition, with POCI assets identified separately.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0). Consistency with the IRB definition of default checked against CRR Art. 178 and EBA/GL/2016/07.

requirements.text: Where IRB parameters are reused, each adjustment (removal of MoC and downturn, TTC-to-PIT conversion, removal of floors, discount rate, lifetime extension) is documented, justified and quantified.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: The SICR assessment compares remaining-lifetime PD at the reporting date with the lifetime PD expected at initial recognition for the same remaining term; use of 12-month PD as a proxy is evidenced as not materially different.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0). Consistent with IFRS 9 paras 5.5.9 and B5.5.13 (paraphrased).

requirements.text: A SICR is identified when the ratio of current to origination annualised lifetime PD exceeds a portfolio-specific relative threshold and the absolute PD increase exceeds a minimum absolute threshold.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Relative and absolute SICR thresholds are calibrated per portfolio, the calibration demonstrates the trade-off between default capture and stage volatility, and thresholds are re-assessed at least annually.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Performing exposures more than 30 days past due on a material amount are allocated to Stage 2; the IFRS 9 rebuttable presumption is not rebutted without an approved dispensation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0). 30 dpd rebuttable presumption per IFRS 9 para 5.5.11 (paraphrased).

requirements.text: Performing exposures with forbearance measures are allocated to Stage 2 for at least the two-year forborne-performing probation period.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Performing exposures of obligors on the watchlist are allocated to Stage 2.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Exposures return to Stage 1 only when no Stage 2 criterion is met, and leave Stage 3 only after completion of the probation period defined in CR-STD-110.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: The origination PD or rating is stored for every facility for its full life; for legacy facilities the proxy approach is documented and its impact on stage allocation analysed.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: PD models provide point-in-time PD term structures over the expected life of each exposure, using the behavioural life for revolving facilities.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: The 12-month PIT PD is calibrated to recently observed portfolio default rates adjusted to current conditions, not to the long-run average default rate.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Cumulative PD curves are monotonically non-decreasing, marginal PDs are non-negative, and PDs revert to long-run levels beyond the forecast period over a documented reversion period.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: LGD estimates are best estimates without downturn adjustment, MoC or regulatory floors, and recoveries and directly attributable costs are discounted at the effective interest rate.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Collateral values of residential mortgages are indexed to the reporting date and projected with the scenario-specific house price index paths of each macroeconomic scenario.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models covering residential mortgage exposures only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: For revolving facilities, the ECL measurement period is the behavioural period of exposure to credit risk estimated from historical data, not the contractual notice period.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0). Revolving-facility exception per IFRS 9 para 5.5.20 (paraphrased).

requirements.text: ECL is computed under at least a baseline, an upside and a downside scenario from the ERM-STD-300 scenario models, with the baseline consistent with the financial planning scenario.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Scenario probability weights are set quarterly with a documented quantitative rationale, and no scenario carries a weight below 10%.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: ECL is calculated separately per scenario and then probability-weighted, and the non-linearity effect versus baseline ECL is reported quarterly.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Macroeconomic variables in satellite models are economically intuitive, have the expected sign, are statistically significant and are tested out of sample, with rejected alternatives documented.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Every overlay is recorded in the overlay register with rationale, model limitation addressed, affected portfolio and stages, quantification method, amount, approval, review date and remediation plan.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Overlays are quantified with an evidence-based method, and expert judgement in the quantification complies with MRM-STD-023.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Overlays above EUR 5 million or 5% of the portfolio loss allowance are approved by the Group Impairment Committee after review by Model Validation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Where an overlay reflects a SICR not captured by the staging model, the affected exposures are also transferred to Stage 2.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Overlays are re-assessed quarterly, and an overlay in place for four consecutive quarters triggers a model change assessment under MRM-STD-050.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: PD development data cover at least five years and, where available, a full economic cycle, and representativeness for the current portfolio is analysed.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: Back-testing is performed at least annually for PIT PD per grade, LGD on closed workouts, CCF, and staging performance including the share of defaults in Stage 2 at least six months before default.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).

requirements.text: A red monitoring outcome under MV-HB-003 leads to a Model Risk Committee-approved remediation plan within three months and an assessment of the need for a temporary overlay.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (FIN-STD-200 v4.0).
